source_checks.fixture: Fresh storage uses guitar.acoustic.6, right handedness and standard tuning. Catalog indices1..6 end with course6 E4 (MIDI64, anchor s1), not physical string6 E2.
source_checks.identifier: CourseGroup.id is the lead Course.index; CourseChip exposes string.group.id as a button identifier, and TuneView preserves rail children using accessibilityElement(children:.contain).
source_checks.gesture_direction: StringRail explicitly forces leftToRight layout in every locale and reverses order only for left-handed settings. A left swipe reveals the rightmost E4 for this fresh right-handed fixture, including RTL phone languages.
source_checks.geometry: The test does not mistake a partially hittable chip for complete reveal: both horizontal edges must fit within app bounds. The preceding vertical-reachability checks place the rail above the tab bar before horizontal gestures. Six finite attempts bound the gesture loop.
source_checks.selection: CourseChip tap chooses the unpaired E4 course; TunerSession.choose(course:) sets selectedCourse and disables automatic retargeting. After the tap, XCTNSPredicateExpectation observes selected == true on that button and XCTWaiter requires completion within5seconds before the screenshot.
source_checks.query_existence: The HStack is not lazy; waitForExistence precedes frame checks, avoiding reading a nonexistent virtualized last chip.
source_checks.concurrency: No new async shared state or environment mutation is introduced; per-language app execution remains sequential with per-run UUID storage.
source_checks.timing_and_actor_isolation: Freshly reread final source uses the established XCTNSPredicateExpectation + XCTWaiter APIs. There is no new wait(for:keyPath...) call or actor annotation. The bounded condition wait resolves the immediate-snapshot timing concern without adding a new MainActor-isolated method call in the nonisolated helper.

nonblocking_recommendations.recommendation: Keep scope reporting explicit: the current AX5 branch runs only for bg. It exercises the physically LTR rail at AX5; it is not proof of RTL-language AX5 interaction, left-handed order or other instruments.
